channel.title: The Awesome Ledger — magictools
channel.description: New entries across the GitHub awesome ecosystem, diffed nightly.

item.title: SimplePixelArt Tileset Editor — via magictools
item.description: Draw auto-tile tilesets in the browser and export them as Godot TileSet (.tres) and Tiled (.tsx) files.

item.title: SimplePixelArt — via magictools
item.description: Free browser pixel art editor with layers, animation frames and palettes; exports PNG, GIF and sprite sheets with Aseprite-style frame tags for game engines.

item.title: QuickMatch — via magictools
item.description: Free comparison of AI tools for making games and AI agent skills for game dev. Prices, free tiers and commercial-use terms come from each vendor's own page with the date checked, plus a matcher that suggests tools from a few questions.

item.title: DDS Tools — via magictools
item.description: Fast DDS texture converter and viewer for game modders that runs in the browser. Converts PNG, JPG, TGA and WebP to BC1, BC3, BC5 or BC7 DDS and DDS back to PNG. Files are processed locally, without uploading to a server.

item.title: Ziva.sh — via magictools
item.description: AI agent plugin inside the Godot editor that edits scenes and scripts, reads editor errors, playtests your game and generates game sound effects from a prompt. On its Pro and Ultra plans, Devlog records your game runs while you build and turns them into 10-15 second vertical devlog videos with captions.

item.title: Pic2Vector — via magictools
item.description: Free in-browser PNG/JPG/WebP to layered SVG tracer for game icons and UI art. Runs locally with WebAssembly (vtracer); no upload, no account, watermark-free export.

item.title: Gridwright Studio — via magictools
item.description: Subscription library of pixel-art game asset packs (tilesets, characters, UI, icons, effects, isometric, music and SFX) for any engine, many with Godot scenes and Tiled tilesets. Free samples with a free account. Drawn in code with AI-assisted tools.

item.title: GameShipKit Sprite Normal Map — via magictools
item.description: Generate normal maps from 2D sprites for lit 2D scenes.

item.title: GameShipKit Map Generator — via magictools
item.description: Seeded dungeon, cave and island maps, exported as PNG, Tiled JSON and CSV.

item.title: GameShipKit Autotile Generator — via magictools
item.description: Make blob and RPG Maker style autotiles from two textures, with Godot 4 and Tiled tilesets.

item.title: GameShipKit 2D Character Rigging — via magictools
item.description: Rig a 2D character in the browser and export idle, walk and attack animations as sprite sheets.

item.title: Unity Asset Exporter — via magictools
item.description: Open .unitypackage files in the browser without Unity and export models as textured GLB.

item.title: SpriteCanvas Sprite Sheet Tools — via magictools
item.description: Free browser tools that slice a sprite sheet into frames, pack images into a sheet, convert GIFs to sheets and back, and turn MP4/WebM clips into sheets with a JSON atlas. Files stay on your device; no account needed.

item.title: SpriteCanvas — via magictools
item.description: AI sprite animation generator for 2D games: make a character from text or an image, animate idle, walk, run, jump and attack moves, and export transparent PNG sprite sheets with a JSON atlas for Phaser, PixiJS and Godot. Free daily credits.

item.title: SlotVFX — via magictools
item.description: Desktop editor for particles and game VFX with Spine support. Free to use; exports for Pixi, Phaser, Cocos Creator and WebGL2 need a paid plan.

item.title: Minecraft Pixel Art — via magictools
item.description: Browser image-to-Minecraft block blueprints with material lists, PNG plans and Java structure NBT export; no account required.

item.title: Flockbay — via magictools
item.description: Free AI game maker built on Godot: a desktop app where an AI agent builds and playtests a Godot 4 project on your disk, on free hosted AI, your own Claude or ChatGPT account, or your own agent over MCP. Optional paid plans add hosted AI usage.

item.title: 3DTexel — via magictools
item.description: 1,600+ handmade CC0 assets: seamless PBR materials (incl. stylized), HDRIs, decals, 3D models and IES lights. A free account may be required for some downloads.

item.title: GameDevTool — via magictools
item.description: Free Roblox monetization calculators for the 30% Marketplace Fee, DevEx cash-out value, UGC creator share and game pass pricing.

item.title: Crisp UI Free — via magictools
item.description: 20 game UI sound effects (clicks, toggles, menu open/close, confirm, error, coin, level up and more) in WAV/OGG; royalty-free for commercial use, no credit required. Synthesized by code written with an AI assistant, no samples or AI audio models.

item.title: Crisp Icons Free — via magictools
item.description: 42 rounded game UI icons in white and dark, as 64 px PNG and SVG; royalty-free for commercial use, no credit required. Drawn procedurally by code written with an AI assistant, no image generators.

item.title: VoxiGen — via magictools
item.description: Voxel editor for building game models and levels in the browser or on desktop, with game-ready export.

item.title: Ludo Toolbox — via magictools
item.description: Free, open-source (MIT) command-line tools that run offline: slice and join spritesheets, find a sprite's feet pivot and box/capsule colliders, check loops, recolor to Lospec palettes, cut tilesets, and export to Godot, Unity, Phaser and TexturePacker. Plain JSON output for scripts and coding agents.

item.title: StudioTwin — via magictools
item.description: All-in-one AI toolkit for game asset generation: any AI agent can generate 3D models, character animation, PBR materials, HDRI environments and sound effects through one MCP connection, using open and commercial models for each job. Integrates with Unreal Engine and imports assets into Blender.

item.title: Riggy — via magictools
item.description: AI rigs a layered PSD into a Spine 4.2 skeleton with animations from a text description; exports plain skeleton.json and atlas.

item.title: PD Sigil Forge — via magictools
item.description: Free browser generator of game-ready magic circles, xianxia formations, sci-fi holo rings, kamon crests and paper talismans for spell VFX; transparent PNG + spin sheets.

item.title: 3D-Agent — via magictools
item.description: AI agent for game-ready 3D assets in Blender: models with clean quad topology and UVs, materials, rigs and animation from plain-language prompts, exported as FBX or GLB for Unity, Unreal and Godot. Also connects to Roblox Studio for scripts, assets and playtests, and builds FiveM / GTA V scenes.

item.title: Wolf RPG Editor English — via magictools
item.description: open source editor for RPG Maker style gamesl

item.title: Turbulenz — via magictools
item.description: Turbulenz offers the ability to build, publish, iterate and monetise high-quality games that react like no others, with immersive 3D effects and real-time physics that open up a whole new world of unprecedented and extraordinary web content.

item.title: Supernova Engine — via magictools
item.description: Cross-platform game engine for 2D and 3D projects with entity component system (ECS) and data-oriented design in C++ and Lua.

item.title: Rpgboss — via magictools
item.description: A 2d rpg game engine and editor based on scala and libgdx. Ease of use, with no programming knowledge.

item.title: Resemble — via magictools
item.description: Resemble's voice cloning engine within Unity

item.title: KogGE — via magictools
item.description: Modern Multiplatform Game Engine for Kotlin. Write games for the JVM, JavaScript, Android and iOS in no time using Kotlin.

item.title: IndieGuild — via magictools
item.description: Free hub where indie devs post roles and find composers, artists, programmers and other creators.

item.title: Horde3D — via magictools
item.description: small open source 3D rendering engine.

item.title: Duke Nukem 3D: Atomic Edition — via magictools
Chipmunk2D — via magictools
item.description: A fast and lightweight 2D game physics library.

item.title: Bullet — via magictools
item.description: Real-time physics simulation.

item.title: Ayatsuri2D — via magictools
item.description: free, open-source 2D mesh rigging editor for Live2D-style puppets: deformers, parameters and physics, exports moc3, with a C ABI (Apache-2.0) to embed models in games. Source

item.title: SpriteForge.tech — via magictools
item.description: AI pixel art generator for sprites, animations and seamless tilesets, with Unity/Godot export and a REST API.

item.title: Proof Engine — via magictools
item.description: Rust rendering and game engine where every visual is math: glyphs and particles moved by ODEs, strange attractors and force fields, with OpenGL post-processing and synth audio.

item.title: Glitchless — via magictools
item.description: Open-source game observability for Three.js, Phaser, Unity, Godot, Unreal and GameMaker: frame times with hitch causes, crashes, where players quit and player bug reports, plus an MCP server so coding agents can read the data and fix what players hit.

item.title: Slip Sound — via magictools
item.description: Fast, local desktop audio sample manager for searching and organizing large sound libraries. No accounts or file caps, with MCP support. Source

item.title: MeshRig — via magictools
item.description: Rig any mesh in a .blend in minutes: fit a starting skeleton, skin weights and IK. Writes a standard Blender armature that works anywhere a Blender rig does. Source

item.title: MeshCoat — via magictools
item.description: Fast, offline desktop texture painter: load a 3D model and paint PBR materials directly onto the mesh, then export texture maps. Source

item.title: MeshAnimate — via magictools
item.description: Pivot-style pose-to-pose animator for rigged Blender characters, with a simple timeline and onion-skin ghosts. Saves animations back into the .blend as normal Blender actions. Source

item.title: DailySounds — via magictools
item.description: Searchable sound effects for games, with browser previews and downloadable audio; free for commercial projects under the DailySounds license.

item.title: RespawnStack — via magictools
item.description: Free directory of pricing, commercial-use and ownership terms for 30+ AI game-dev tools. Each verified row cites its source (vendor page or Steamworks docs) with a link and date.
